body:
SYNTHETIC DATA · DRAFT ONLY
Practice session draft

Inspect four proposed administrative practice sessions for two fictional people. This local helper checks the supplied limits and finds times from your allowed choices. It does not issue a schedule or establish operational compliance.

Start with the example below. Inspect the result, then mark it reviewed and save a draft file before closing. Nothing is sent anywhere.

1. Inspect the four requests

Change durations or allowed starts to try another synthetic scenario. Each edit recomputes the result and clears review. Assigned people, rooms and required qualifications stay fixed.

All times are integer minutes from the start of day 1. Day 1 starts at 0; day 2 starts at 1440. Enter starts separated by commas, such as 0, 90. A blank list leaves no allowed start. Intervals include the start and exclude the end; the rest gap is checked separately.

All requests remain required
Request	Person	Room	Requires	Duration, min	Allowed start minutes
A	P01	Room-1	Q-A		
B	P01	Room-1	Q-A		
C	P02	Room-2	Q-B		
D	P02	Room-2	Q-B		
Inspect or edit synthetic constraints

The example uses operating and both-person availability windows 0 to 240 and 1440 to 1680. Each entire session must fit one window. Limits apply across both days combined. Editing these values defines a new synthetic scenario. Search never changes a constraint or adds a qualification.

2. Inspect the result
Feasible draft

All four requests fit the current supplied constraints. This is a draft for inspection, not an issued schedule.

Next: inspect the times and personnel totals, mark the current draft reviewed, then save a draft file.

All four requests and fixed assignments are present.
Full sessions fit operating and assigned-person availability windows.
Supplied qualifications, person rest, room exclusivity and whole-horizon limits pass.

Candidate attempts: 5 of 50000. Feasibility is over listed starts only, not global optimization. Conflicts are observations, not a minimal conflict set.

When a draft is present, select another allowed start to inspect a person-selected draft. Every selection is independently checked and clears review. A conflicting selection is invalid draft input, not proof that the allowed choices are infeasible. Find draft again returns to automatic search.

P01	120	120	120

3. Review and keep your draft

Not reviewed. Inspect the current draft before marking it reviewed.

Mark reviewed only after inspecting every request, time and constraint. This records acknowledgement on this page. It is not authorization to issue a schedule.

Mark current draft reviewed
Save before you close

No automatic storage is used. Save draft file downloads a JSON copy of the exact inputs and draft, including errors if present. Keep that file and index.html. Reopen index.html, then use Import draft file to recover. Import rechecks the file and always clears review. File transfer is not reconnect synchronization.

Save draft file
Import draft file

Search rerun from current input. Review cleared.

Partial ID 11 demonstration. Synthetic and unclassified only. No real people, ships, units or records. No recurrence, SFTRM interpretation, departmental negotiation or agents, real readiness data, qualification policy beyond supplied values, official-calendar writes or reconnect sync.

A coordinator remains in charge. If a result looks wrong, leave it unreviewed, save the draft and ask the responsible human to inspect the inputs. No contact or operational-system updates occur here. Close the page to stop using it.
